recipes.name: Tortilla Agave Latte
recipes.method: Pull espresso. Add agave to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Matcha Jelly Oat Shot
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha with water, agave, salt. Set jelly with agar agar. Cut into cubes. Pour Oatly Barista over jelly and ice.
recipes.notes: Agar agar ratio: 2g per 200ml liquid

recipes.name: Acai Frozen Flat
recipes.method: Blend Oatly, acai, agave and ice until smooth. Pour into glass. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Lemon Espresso Cherry
recipes.method: Add cherry syrup and lemon juice to glass. Add ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: The Grape Cooler
recipes.method: Add agave and lime juice to glass. Fill with ice. Pour grape juice. Top with Oatly Barista Edition.

recipes.name: Teas and Black Sugar
recipes.method: Brew black tea strong and cool. Add black sugar to glass with ice. Pour tea. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Iced Sweet & Salty Popcorn Latte
recipes.method: Drizzle caramel in glass. Add ice. Pour Oatly Popcorn. Top with espresso. Pinch of salt. Garnish with popcorn.

recipes.name: Popcorn Peppermint Mocha
recipes.method: Add chocolate sauce and peppermint syrup to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Popcorn. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Banana Popcorn Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha. Add banana puree to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Popcorn. Pour matcha over top.

recipes.name: Caramel Miso Latte
recipes.method: Dissolve miso in espresso while hot. Add ice to glass. Pour Oatly Caramel. Top with miso espresso.
recipes.notes: White or shiro miso works best — subtle and sweet

recipes.name: Caramel Apple Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha. Add apple juice to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Caramel. Float matcha on top.

recipes.name: Strawberry & Rose Matcha
recipes.method: Add strawberry puree and rose syrup to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float cold brew matcha on top.
recipes.notes: Serve layered — don't mix until drinking

recipes.name: Mango Refresher
recipes.method: Add mango pulp and cardamom syrup to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista over gently.
recipes.notes: Can also use mint syrup instead of cardamom

recipes.name: Iced Gochujang Chocolate
recipes.method: Dissolve chocolate and gochujang in hot water. Cool slightly. Add ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with chocolate-gochujang base.
recipes.notes: Start with 3g gochujang and adjust to taste

recipes.name: Black Sugar Hojicha
recipes.method: Cold brew hojicha. Add black sugar syrup to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float hojicha on top.

recipes.name: French Toast Cold Brew
recipes.method: Add vanilla and cinnamon syrups to glass. Ice. Pour cold brew. Add Oatly Barista. Top with vanilla cold foam.
recipes.notes: Vanilla cold foam: blend Oatly Barista with vanilla syrup until foamy

recipes.name: Strawberry Matcha Classic
recipes.method: Layer strawberry puree at bottom. Add ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float cold brew matcha on top.

recipes.name: Strawberry Matcha Cold Foam
recipes.method: Layer strawberry. Ice. Pour matcha + Oatly Barista. Top with cold foam.

recipes.name: Pandan Melon Cold Latte
recipes.method: Add pandan and melon syrups to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso. Finish with a pinch of toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
recipes.notes: Flavor arc: coffee base → floral/herbal → fresh sweet melon → citric/electric finish. Use washed Ethiopian roast for best synergy. Sichuan pepper can also be infused into pandan syrup.

recipes.name: Osmanthus Espresso Latte
recipes.method: Add osmanthus syrup and yuzu to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.
recipes.notes: Osmanthus notes: apricot, peach, honey, tea flower. Very delicate — don't overpower with strong roast. Yuzu adds citric/floral lift without dominating.

recipes.name: Osmanthus Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha with less agave (osmanthus already sweet). Add osmanthus + yuzu to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha.
recipes.notes: Cardamom verde works as yuzu alternative. Shiro possible but riskier. Pair: osmanthus + matcha as menu duo with shared thread.

recipes.name: Papaya & Basil Seed Smoothie
recipes.method: Soak basil seeds for 10 min. Blend Oatly, papaya, lime and agave until smooth. Pour over ice. Top with basil seeds.

recipes.name: Teas & Black Sugar
recipes.method: Brew black tea strong and cool. Add black sugar to glass with ice. Pour tea. Top with Oatly Barista Edition.

recipes.name: Koji Caramel Hot Choc
recipes.method: Melt chocolate in warm Oatly over low heat. Stir in koji caramel. Finish with a pinch of salt. Serve hot.
recipes.notes: Koji caramel: fermented koji adds umami-sweet depth. Shiro miso can substitute.

recipes.name: Campfire Latte
recipes.method: Prepare smoked sugar syrup. Add syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Osmanthus Cold Brew Tonic
recipes.method: Make osmanthus syrup: steep 5g flowers in 100ml boiling water 5-7 min, strain, add 100g sugar. Foam Oatly Cold Foam with osmanthus syrup. Add ice and 20ml osmanthus syrup to glass. Top with tonic water and cold brew. Finish with cold foam.
recipes.notes: Osmanthus syrup recipe: 5g flowers, 100ml hot water, 100g white sugar.

recipes.name: Pomelo, White Tea & Chocolate
recipes.method: Drizzle chocolate sauce in glass. Add ice. Mix white tea and pomelo juice. Pour Oatly Barista. Pour tea mixture over.

recipes.name: Mate Cola Latte
recipes.method: Brew mate and cool. Add cola syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with cold mate.

recipes.name: Fig Leaf Matcha
recipes.method: Make fig leaf syrup by simmering fig leaves with sugar and water. Cold brew matcha. Layer in glass: fig leaf syrup, ice, Oatly, matcha.
recipes.notes: Fig leaf has a coconut-woody flavour. Substitute: toasted coconut syrup.

recipes.name: Oat Tepache
recipes.method: Ferment tepache 3-4 days (pineapple rind, piloncillo, cinnamon, cloves, water). Strain and chill. Add ice to glass. Pour tepache. Top with Oatly Barista.
recipes.notes: 4-day fermentation. Serve immediately once poured — fizzy.

recipes.name: Persimmon Cold Brew
recipes.method: Add persimmon puree and agave to glass. Fill with ice. Pour cold brew. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Matcha Jell-Oat Shot
recipes.method: Dissolve agar agar in warm matcha + agave. Pour into tray and set. Cut into cubes. Place matcha jelly in glass. Pour Oatly Barista over.
recipes.notes: Agar ratio: 2g per 200ml liquid.

recipes.name: Mochi Matcha
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha. Add mochi pieces to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha on top.

recipes.name: Lychee Oolong & Jell-Oat
recipes.method: Set agar agar jelly with oolong tea. Cut into cubes. Add lychee syrup to glass. Add jelly and ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with oolong.

recipes.name: Hojicha Old Fashioned
recipes.method: Brew strong hojicha concentrate. Combine hojicha, Oatly, maple syrup and bitters in mixing glass with ice. Stir until cold. Strain into glass over large ice cube. Express orange peel.
recipes.notes: Clarification optional for visual impact.

recipes.name: Tortilla & Agave Latte
recipes.method: Warm Oatly + tortilla chips + agave over low heat 5 min. Cool and strain. Rim glass with agave and crushed spicy chips. Fill with ice. Add infused Oatly. Finish with espresso.
recipes.notes: Infuse at low heat — do not boil.

recipes.name: Lemon Espresso con Cherry
recipes.method: Add cherry syrup and lemon juice to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Brazilian Lemonade
recipes.method: Blend all ingredients until smooth (30s-1min). Strain out lime residue. Serve over lots of ice immediately.
recipes.notes: Must be consumed immediately. Do not let it sit — it separates.

recipes.name: Ashotchu (A-shot-choo)
recipes.method: Mix yuzu and honey. Add to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Ube Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Add ube syrup to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float cold brewed matcha on top.
recipes.notes: Ube gives striking purple colour — serve layered.

recipes.name: Tomato Vine Soda Float
recipes.method: Add basil syrup to glass with ice. Pour tomato vine juice and sparkling water. Float Oatly Barista on top.
recipes.notes: Unexpected savoury float — great for brunch menus.

recipes.name: Rosemary Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Make rosemary syrup (rosemary + sugar + water). Cold brew matcha. Add rosemary syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly. Float matcha.

recipes.name: Coffee & Cranachan
recipes.method: Add raspberry and oat syrups to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.
recipes.notes: Inspired by the Scottish dessert cranachan. Toasted oat syrup: toast oats, steep in sugar syrup.

recipes.name: Miso Banana Cubano Blanco
recipes.method: Dissolve miso in warm espresso. Cool. Add banana syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly. Top with miso espresso.

recipes.name: Smokey Matcha
recipes.method: Make smoked sugar syrup. Add syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha on top.

recipes.name: The Snowcap
recipes.method: Add jasmine syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha. Top with thick Oatly Cold Foam.

recipes.name: The No Brainer
recipes.method: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Tea x Coffee Latte
recipes.method: Brew Earl Grey strong and cool. Add vanilla syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly. Layer cold brew tea. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Cherry Bakewell Dirty Soda
recipes.method: Add cherry and almond syrups to glass with ice. Pour sparkling water. Float Oatly Barista on top.

recipes.name: Horchata Latte
recipes.method: Add horchata syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso. Dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Maple Miso Latte
recipes.method: Dissolve miso in espresso. Add maple syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Add miso espresso.
recipes.notes: Also works hot: steam Oatly with miso and maple, top with espresso.

recipes.name: Lacto-Fermented Blueberry Matcha
recipes.method: Ferment blueberries with salt 3-5 days. Strain and make shrub with sugar and vinegar. Add shrub to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha.
recipes.notes: Advanced fermentation technique — plan 3-5 days ahead.

recipes.name: Coconut Matcha Cloud
recipes.method: Add coconut syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha. Top with thick cold foam.

recipes.name: Guajillo Cold Brew Latte
recipes.method: Make guajillo syrup (dried chili + sugar + water). Add syrup to glass with ice. Pour cold brew. Top with Oatly Barista.
recipes.notes: Guajillo: mild fruity heat with berry notes.

recipes.name: Salty Banana Split
recipes.method: Blend Oatly, banana, caramel and ice until smooth. Pour. Drizzle chocolate. Finish with salt.

recipes.name: Apricot & Thyme Matcha
recipes.method: Blend apricots, thyme and sugar for puree. Add 30g puree to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly. Finish with cold brewed matcha.
recipes.notes: Timesaver: swap Barista + matcha for 240ml Oatly Matcha Oat Drink.

recipes.name: Mango Sticky Rice Slushie
recipes.method: Blend Oatly, mango, coconut syrup and ice until slushy. Pour. Top with a spoonful of sticky rice.

recipes.name: Strawberry & Almond Shrub
recipes.method: Make strawberry shrub (strawberries + sugar + apple cider vinegar, 3 days). Add shrub and almond syrup to glass with ice. Top with sparkling water and Oatly.

recipes.name: Lime & Leaf Chai
recipes.method: Make kaffir lime leaf syrup. Add syrup to glass with ice. Pour chai concentrate. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Rose Cardamom Coffee Cloud
recipes.method: Add rose and cardamom syrups to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso. Finish with cold foam.

recipes.name: Guava & Coconut Shaken Espresso
recipes.method: Shake espresso, guava syrup and ice vigorously. Pour into glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista gently. Add coconut syrup.

recipes.name: Cantaloupe Matcha
recipes.method: Add cantaloupe puree and agave to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha on top.

recipes.name: Peach Sago Tea
recipes.method: Cook sago pearls. Add peach syrup and sago to glass. Fill with ice. Pour peach tea. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Banana French Toast Brûlée
recipes.method: Add syrups to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista and espresso. Top with cold foam. Sprinkle sugar on foam and brûlée with torch.

recipes.name: Ginger Nut Chai
recipes.method: Add ginger and biscuit syrups to glass with ice. Pour chai concentrate. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Pear & Cardamom Thai Tea
recipes.method: Add pear and cardamom syrups to glass with ice. Pour Thai tea. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Mulled Cranberry Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Make mulled cranberry syrup (cranberry juice + mulling spices + sugar). Add syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha.

recipes.name: Gochujang Hot Chocolate
recipes.method: Melt chocolate in warm Oatly. Stir in gochujang and agave. Finish with salt. Serve hot.
recipes.notes: Start with 3g gochujang — adjust to taste.

recipes.name: Ye Olde Oatly
recipes.method: Brew strong filter coffee. Add salted vanilla syrup to glass. Pour hot coffee. Layer Oatly Organic. Finish with cold foam on top like a stout head.
recipes.notes: Inspired by a traditional British stout.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Roll Smoothie
recipes.method: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Smoked Rosemary Hot Choc
recipes.method: Smoke rosemary sprig and steep in syrup. Melt chocolate in warm Oatly. Stir in smoked rosemary syrup and salt. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Double Tea
recipes.method: Brew both teas strong and cool. Add honey to glass with ice. Layer black tea. Pour Oatly Barista. Float green tea on top.

recipes.name: Apple Pie Chai
recipes.method: Add apple pie syrup to glass with ice. Pour chai concentrate. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Malted Spiced Choco
recipes.method: Heat Oatly gently. Dissolve malt powder and chocolate. Add spice and agave. Stir well. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Yuzu White Choc Mocha
recipes.method: Add white chocolate sauce and yuzu to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Sticky Toffee Irish Coffee
recipes.method: Add sticky toffee syrup to glass. Pour hot coffee. Add Oatly Barista. Top with cold foam. Drizzle caramel.

recipes.name: Carrot Cake Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Make carrot cake syrup (carrot juice + warm spices + sugar). Add syrup and cinnamon to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly. Float matcha.

recipes.name: Chia Pudding Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Soak chia seeds in Oatly overnight. Add matcha and agave to glass with chia. Fill with ice. Float cold brewed matcha.
recipes.notes: Prepare chia overnight.

recipes.name: Sweet Tahini Hojicha Latte
recipes.method: Blend tahini with agave until smooth. Add to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with hojicha concentrate.

recipes.name: Pumpkin 2.0
recipes.method: Add pumpkin spice syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso. Finish with a few drops of pumpkin seed oil.
recipes.notes: The oil adds unexpected depth and visual drama.

recipes.name: Black Sesame Hojicha Einspänner
recipes.method: Mix hojicha, black sesame paste and agave. Add ice to glass. Pour mixture. Top generously with Oatly Cold Foam. Served in a tall glass like an einspänner.
recipes.notes: Black sesame paste gives deep nutty-bitter flavour.

recipes.name: Salted 'Egg' Custard Latte
recipes.method: Make vegan custard syrup with Oatly, turmeric, cornstarch and sugar. Cool. Add custard syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso. Finish with pinch of salt.
recipes.notes: Turmeric gives the golden custard colour without eggs.
